name: Gasthof-Ferienwohnung Stimmersee
beschreibung:
Situated right on the shore of pristine Lake Stimmersee, this property features cosy guestrooms, apartments, and regional dining. Guests enjoy direct private access to the refreshing lake waters.

Hiking routes up Mount Pendling, riverside cycling paths, and Kufstein Fortress are only minutes away.
kurzbeschreibung: Gasthof & Ferienwohnungen Stimmersee in Langkampfen provides lakeside bliss and relaxation in Kufsteinerland.
